'''1997 Yavin 4 Regionals (Charlotte)''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier for the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]], one of two in the Yavin 4 region (Virginia, Washington D.C., West Virginia, Kentucky, Tennessee, North Carolina, South Carolina, Maryland, Delaware).<ref name="dec97q">[http://www.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html 1997 Regionals and Open Events], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/19990503132332/http://search.decipher.com/starwars/specialevents/current/97worldfinals/regionalsandopens.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Regional qualifier (Yavin 4)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Dagobah]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 14 June 1997
* '''Site:''' Heroes '97, Charlotte, North Carolina
